title: polianthes oliveriana
intro: Polianthes oliveriana, commonly known as the 'Tahina' or 'Mexican Lily', is a plant species belonging to the Asparagaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering relief from respiratory issues and promoting relaxation. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help reduce stress and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents present in Polianthes oliveriana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
